subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should it run only in an explicit check/Doctor path?
rationale: The source gap is real, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior, so the permanent product boundary needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with clear remediation and configured-root exclusions.

options.title: Add Startup/Status Warning Too
options.body: Also surface warnings during startup or status, accepting more operator-visible noise and runtime filesystem scanning.

options.title: Document Current Scope Only
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs rather than adding off-root discovery.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor with clear remediation and configured-root exclusions.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice crosses skills CLI, bundled skill-creator history, and operator diagnostic UX where Peter has the strongest feature-history trail.
